question: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021?
sql:
WITH year_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.segment,
        f.fiscal_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.product_code) as unique_product_count
    FROM hardware_dim_product d
    JOIN hardware_fact_sales_monthly f ON d.product_code = f.product_code
    WHERE f.fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY d.segment, f.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
    segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_product_count END) as unique_product_count_2020
FROM year_counts
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY (1.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2021 THEN unique_product_count END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_product_count END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 2020 THEN unique_product_count END)) * 100 DESC
